verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents an LLM inference story for the H200: Llama2 70B is 1.9x faster and GPT-3 175B is 1.6x faster than H100, and NIM microservices for generative AI deployment come via AI Enterprise. A community report confirms Llama 405B served in production on H200 SXM. However, the pack never mentions low-precision formats or names any supported serving stack. Missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 precision support, explicit TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support for this part, independent serving-stack benchmarks.
